Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review original research article that focuses on modeling renewable energy requirements for Indonesia’s new capital city (IKN) using geospatial data. While it uses land use/land cover (LULC) classification and references urban growth scenarios from another study (Hackbarth, 2021), LULC prediction is not the primary objective—it serves as an input to energy infrastructure assessment. Moreover, the study is explicitly regional/local in scale (focused on the IKN area in East Kalimantan, ~180,000 ha), not national-scale. It fails the core inclusion criterion of “explicit national-scale spatial implementation” and also does not implement its own ≥2 future LULC scenarios with quantitative comparison; instead, it adopts a single large-size scenario for energy analysis. Thus, it meets exclusion criteria due to local/regional scale focus and lack of primary LULC prediction focus.)
